correctness.rationale: At delta=s the second equilibrium equation is s(u-v²)=0, so setting z=v>0 gives u=z² and the first equation zP(z)/(m+z²)=0 with P(z)=-h z⁵+(1-e-s-hm)z³+sz²-m(e+s)z+sm. P(0)>0>P(infinity); P=-20hz³+6cz+2s crosses zero exactly once, so P′ rises then falls and has at most two positive zeros. Exactly 3 simple roots iff local minimum P(a)<0 and local maximum P(b)>0. Differentiating along nullcline gives detJ=-szP′/(m+z²); P′>0 saddle, P′<0 det>0 and negative trace hence LAS. Witness (m,e,h,s,delta)=(1,2/5,1/10,1/5,1/5) has exact rational alternating signs at 1/3,1/2,1,3/2,8/5 and simple stable/saddle/stable roots; hyperbolicity persists under perturbation of all parameters. Independently checked symbolic polynomial reduction, determinant identity and witness values. Degenerate-root nonlinear stability and arbitrary unbalanced global counts not established.
